scope: Publish exact source/results bytes with bounded, reconstructible byte chunks.

summary.scope: Publish complete covered-contact fields or independently qualified reference methods without accepting unresolved physical convergence.

covered_CAD_full_fields.scope: Compare independently audited covered CAD egg fields at identical physical times; geometry and contact axes remain coupled.
covered_CAD_full_fields.limitations: Two covered meshes approximate the same declared CAD geometry at fixed material/density, friction, original held closure/control and physical timestep. Represented volume/mass and geometry differ explicitly. Bulk, surface geometry and body contact trace vary together; this is not a separated axis or a physical tail. Separate all-five-state audits qualify original force gates. Full raw corner/global bounds, objective common-point tensors and source arrays remain intact. This short stationary window does not establish complete original application, contact/space/regularization convergence, model/feedback or warmed accuracy/cost.

independent_second_CAD_audit.scope: Independently verify every precision-aware spatial state and its unaveraged global field.
independent_second_CAD_audit.limitations: Every original dynamic step is independently reconstructed, including exact previous-state/velocity integration, unsmoothed centered normal/friction stencils, mass/armature and capped jaw PD. Raw global wide-coordinate field bounds remain visible. The original fixed-arm/two-jaw control and saved held initializer remain explicit. Full-arm application matching and physical spatial/contact/geometry convergence are separate incomplete requirements.

second_contact_coverage.scope: Locate independently audited contact samples relative to fixed numerical refinement caps.
second_contact_coverage.limitations: Reference contact-sample positions are mapped to the same angular parameter used for numerical mesh marking; this is not a geodesic distance or resolved physical contact boundary. Unsigned sample-force norms avoid cancellation of opposing jaws and are not a traction-area integral. Incident trace edges are measured in the undeformed collision discretization. Samples outside caps reveal coverage gaps; samples inside caps do not exclude missed contact caused by coarse geometry elsewhere. No stress smoothing, force/geometry modification, convergence acceptance or original goal completion follows.

fixed_body_U_pad_axis.scope: Reconstruct nonlinear U equilibrium and compare objective fields across resolved contact meshes.
fixed_body_U_pad_axis.limitations: Every retained accepted-step residual record is checked; only final complete fields were saved. Independent nonlinear bulk equilibrium is reconstructed with the retained final nodal contact forces, not a missing friction history. Proper finite frames and direct P2 deformation-gradient evaluation at common material points avoid stress interpolation and infinitesimal-rotation assumptions. The declared axis and semantic geometry hashes distinguish coupled, fixed-body pad and fixed-pad body studies. Body CAD/volume and pad geometry/volume/contact resolution still require their own separated checks. Probe norms are diagnostics rather than continuum integrals; two levels cannot establish a tail. Discrete masses are recorded without density retuning. Full history/contact reconstruction, separated axes, refined contact references, native finite footprints, actual Franka, feedback and verified warmed accuracy/cost remain separate requirements.

manual_checks: Readable unclipped labels/legends and aligned panel letters.
Matched0–50MPa scale, actual contact samples, independently identified raw peaks and0.4mm insets.
Continuous stress uses viridis; refinement categories use colour plus marker/line differences.
All deterministic source values retained; no uncertainty bars, smoothing, or convergence-order fit.
remaining_scientific_limitations: Two CAD levels do not establish a physical tail.
Conditional U pad tail does not close body/geometry/contact/regularization.

limitations: All five second-level CAD states pass independent original force gates and contact coverage. The158340-probe comparison retains complete corners/fields: tensor9.68%, energy0.407%, raw peak13.89%; two coupled bulk/geometry/contact levels are not physical convergence. The U pad5/7/9 sequence keeps body geometry/mass fixed and has a conditional1.20% last tensor change; body/geometry and regularization remain separate. OOM, original-tolerance manufactured-field failures and partial source-setup failure are preserved with true status. Figure scalar/vector/raster QA does not establish physical accuracy. Files of at least50MB are preserved as exact ordered32MiB byte ranges, individually gzip-compressed, with original/part/stored SHA256 and offsets. Join decompressed ranges in index order to restore the original file exactly; no records are reduced or excluded. Runtime staging uses hard links for unchanged small originals.
